name: PDFium 159.0.8138.0
body:
This version was built with branch `chromium/8138` of PDFium
### Changes
Commits between `chromium/8125` and `chromium/8138`:
* [Use AutoRestorer to scope script_node_array_ in CFXJSE_Engine](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/5f092b52993bfd98f94f04deff391918fe0fdcfd)
* [Remove pdf_skia_font_manager_target GN argument.](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/4cd9288dd29bf300257d18f5abf214dc99f54382)
* [Make embedder tests more forgiving of missing FT/Skia libraries.](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/d2c2be2144908f6508ffbb4cbe349240b9375203)
* [Vectorize scanline-compositor paths](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/4e36424cbe4d665e1b115a88184640267248a8a8)
* [Add generic GCed containers in fxjs/gc/containers.h](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/f47593101fd538060484147c65ac88e42bec4e99)
* [Enable PartitionAlloc in standalone Skia builds](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/320708bfb4d8c97d3878631a94f95073b1c8af42)
* [[3p freshness] lcms: Roll to 2.19.1 and enable auto-update](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/55ed4ec4229365f466d9d634956bb088b1c3a399)
* [Fix a nit in CGdiDisplayDriver::GetDIBits()](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/83adc17d6472612f291764bd1099a5933bcd58d5)
* [Roll build, tools/clang and tools/rust](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/dbd70172777845e9acd48e32d18f7cbf0edbb636)
* [Roll abseil, buildtools and libc++](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/df710bcbf0d9abea61767f00894314e4efb195df)
* [Roll base/allocator/partition_allocator/ dc6144ac9..2b864a177 (50 commits)](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/32aa2c3aaadd63a3da1108a4a27e552f74dd889b)
* [Pass zero strides to libyuv for single-row operations](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/14b34d999240ebf1ec9f51962538e4b07a5f01eb)
* [Roll third_party/rust/ b8c38a533..79a8603b9 (52 commits)](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/864b2ebddd1b13fb4045680528671463490c866b)
* [Roll testing/scripts/rust/ 9c16e2f4c..9022dfb9a (1 commit)](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/b435cef44c63aadf424335091efa4cd67455014b)
* [Roll third_party/skia/ 5b1a7f7c0..0abfcf118 (368 commits; 17 trivial rolls)](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/c0cb3e496e924b0626b16a41ed3aa23df65fcb7c)
* [Fix three additional embeddertest results on *_skia_rust CQ bots.](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/b2b9e0fea93ec37351c062292a91ef24167ca270)
* [Fix a UNSAFE_TODO() in JpegModule::JpegEncode()](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/f96a940dc0453411e58d749c4b986dd0b0474fa8)
* [Fix incorrect documentation in core/fxcrt/zip.h](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/009acc7bd593902d948d33c9621c82c3a513f80a)
* [Add documentation about CI/CQ and build recipes.](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/5dfa486ae433f87e1ecff1407e68bcda52d4329a)
* [Test all 4 ordering variants of /ActualText for an Arabic string](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/64df52afe4740704c46334938fedca9d72e82fd3)
* [Make non-const kFoo variables truly const](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/67cc30230f327e0c9c2c1a82a2dbf8d2f23541a3)
* [Enable Brotli compilation override by default](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/5b8d8c787c603f5dad771e96dc203f19bb638925)
* [Remove unused GpStream class and unused GDI+ functions](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/2dbda71a1ece22186717044e6db571d6deb54932)
* [Convert remaining embedder tests to display list comparisons](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/efb72020904e509a419813159bc5104d46a6d122)
* [Use display lists for Brotli stream tests](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/0f3d165beb72d31936fdde7243cc08b42ba03cfa)
* [Use display lists for blank page checks in pattern and save tests](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/181518ea0915a75189a1d890feee7e9df3a4099e)
* [Actually initialize `CPDF_SyntaxParser::pool_`](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/6876f741cdda2f4d2ca95dca510a144568f6dcc5)
* [Use display lists for FPDFEditPageEmbedderTest](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/57e9a26671f759c82e9dc982df252769e627289d)
* [Use display lists for FPDFEditPathEmbedderTest](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/87bd4872625193b6af4593f4f83d40c2eecae155)
* [Roll third_party/libyuv/ eb8eda9c7..1e2e3a359 (8 commits)](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/ac04d23ea251ab61862c533a2a182d03ca1fd246)
* [Use display lists for FPDFTransformEmbedderTest](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/a5a0f99ffd780d5bbc457fe8d319b02ff98b95d2)
* [Teach tools/roll_pdfium_deps.py about libyuv](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/7241409b3c3b0837520d8961a0b22a261676131b)
* [Add CPDFCreatorEmbedderTest for handling free entries](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/7a364ab9b0adb206bff584bd4884265fc91cce65)
* [Remove unused buildtools/reclient from DEPS and roll script](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/b69c9b18ab9e5e2b330f8df4a2e109939d82f592)
* [Use fuzzy float equality in CFX_Path::GetRect()](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/8e5483c622e56080f4222aaf8746bd1042fad884)
* [Fix incorrect PDF major version in save header](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/d36b525a88713711f9bae0c793e23b55766a280f)
* [Add test for PDF 2.0 file save header issue](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/17e04655e5f9d5cabf12a6f24aa373f6463d8554)
* [Allow for headers with specific versions in fixup_pdf_template.py](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/8325c530ca92255c49de0568d241c50dde134f7a)
* [Move ScopedLocale to core/fxcrt and use in DisplayListDeviceDriver](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/ae6ae3ca9a5088507c9a3afbacf2ce3484dabdd2)
* [Add unit tests for near-axis-aligned rectangles in CFX_Path](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/2b2d56c7929f20fa61713121d868e8bb0f0aca1a)
* [Optimize AGG clip region mask intersection](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/4a72657f702e21325a30f7e05bd49125daefc688)
* [Add unit tests for CFX_AggClipRgn](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/19b828e9a651da843c6cf696ad9d4e5ca064619f)
* [Use incremental affine stepping in DrawAxialShading()](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/2f8880782ee79e24466642ccb7309c0a74ccc483)
* [Handle zero-length gradient axis in DrawAxialShading()](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/93ba3fc5e28e9004d51e9739a7706803d5d7a227)
* [Mark several RAII classes as [[maybe_unused, nodiscard]].](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/60c86bb41f066e352eeafe2647f742b0dddde038)
* [Support move semantics in AutoRestorer](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/97f8540a9f75630677e84007224d54af0b0389b4)
* [Roll Code Coverage from a81032f8d6f5 to 084f00efb99d (9 revisions)](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/09c6ccf13811f1c2b812b1c401b7a1ad455c2641)
* [Add another pixel test for /DeviceCMYK colorspace](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/7b3f6f93625e6df97a7d9e677137a558df8648c4)
